title: A finite extension of a separably closed field is separably closed and embeds uniquely into an algebraically closed field
statement: Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-pc-separably-closed] and $L/K$ a finite field extension [def-pc-field-extension]. Then: (a) $L$ is separably closed; (b) for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and every field homomorphism $\iota:K\to\Omega$ there is exactly one field homomorphism $\lambda:L\to\Omega$ with $\lambda|_K=\iota$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 030K (lemma-separable-first: L has a subextension L_sep/K separable with L/L_sep purely inseparable; L_sep = K as K is separably closed, so L/K is purely inseparable); (a): a separable polynomial over L has its roots separable over L, hence algebraic over K, and the separable closure argument of 030K applied to L(root)/K shows the root lies in L; (b): Lemma Tag 09HJ (lemma-separable-degree) and its proof ('when K/F is purely inseparable ... there is a unique map K -> Fbar'), the image of L lying in the algebraic closure of iota(K) inside Omega; existence by Lemma Tag 09GU (lemma-map-into-algebraic-closure). Used in the proof of Etale Cohomology Proposition Tag 03QP: 'Since the residue field of O^sh is separably closed the same is true for each A_i'
